description: Human elder portrait variants. Grey hair and a slightly stooped walking pose are fixed; one portrait per skin tone and gender.
source: OpenAI Images API (images.edit) using the matching adult grey-hair variant as reference; gpt-image-2.5-flare, medium quality; Lanczos downscale to 300x600.
